data.name: Harz
data.gender_notes: Harz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Harz is derived from the Arabic word 'harasa' which means 'to strike, hit, or throw a stone'. It can be interpreted as a symbol of strength, resilience, and endurance, as a rock or stone remains unyielding in the face of adversity. The name Harz carries the meaning “A rock, a stone” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Harz usually hope their child will grow to embody a rock, a stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
